fields.description: The doctype people may read their own records of. A doctype with no enabled record here is not self-service, whatever anyone's permissions say.
fields.label: Document Type

fields.description: Turn off to withdraw this record type from self service without deleting how it was configured.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Field to read as the record's name in a list or a queue. Defaults to the record's id.
fields.label: Title Field

fields.description: One record per owner, so a page can ask for "mine" without naming it -- an employee record. Leave clear where an owner may have several, such as bank accounts, and the page lists them.
fields.label: One Per Owner

fields.description: Field on this doctype that says whose record it is. A Link to User names the owner outright; anything else names a record of Owner Document Type, and ownership follows that.
fields.label: Owner Field

fields.description: Set when Owner Field points at another self-service record rather than at a User -- a bank account names its Employee. Leave blank when the field names a User.
fields.label: Owner Document Type

fields.description: Extra conditions a record must meet before it counts as somebody's, as JSON -- {"status": "Active"} stops a leaver's record being theirs to read. Leave blank for none.
fields.label: Record Filters

fields.description: What the page shows and what may be proposed. Order here is the order on the page.
fields.label: Fields
